name: Lizard Island Resort
positioning: Island resort set within a National Park on the Great Barrier Reef, off the North Queensland coast, with daily dining included in the nightly rate
best_for: Snorkellers and divers who want reef within reach of the beach
Couples and families with children aged 10 and over

facts.text: Lizard Island Resort is set within a National Park and surrounded by 24 secluded white-sand beaches.
Lizard Island is the most northern resort on the Great Barrier Reef, surrounded by 1,000 hectares of National Park.
Lizard Island is a continental island 28km from the North Queensland coast, surrounded by fringing reefs.
The island is about two hundred kilometers north of Cairns.
An easy 10-minute swim reaches the fringing reef.
Activities include snorkelling, diving, paddle boarding, kayaking, hiking, visits to the Lizard Island Research Station, tennis under night lights and morning yoga on the beach.
The Lizard Island Research Station is a coral reef research facility owned and operated by the Australian Museum.
Oceanview Villas sit high along a ridge overlooking the Coral Sea.
A freshwater swimming pool sits between the Resort Lodge and Essentia Day Spa.
Essentia Spa uses and sells Sodashi spa products.
Daily dining is included in the nightly rate.
Lizard Island was declared a National Park in 1937.

highlights.text: Dive sites such as the Cod Hole are 45 minutes from shore.
The Clam Gardens are a short swim from the beach at Watson's Bay, with other snorkel sites at Anchor Bay and Sunset Beach.
The Beachfront Suites are set along the arc of Anchor Bay with direct beach access.
Oceanview Plunge Pool Villas have their own private plunge pool.
Guests can take a private dinghy with a refreshments pack and motor to a beach of their choice.

considerations.text: Lizard Island Resort caters to children 10 years old and over.
Divers may not fly for at least 24 hours after their last dive, and most guests fly to and from the island.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires charter flight access.
